IncidentBot: PAGER: P0 - Helion Corp (enterprise-vpc) websocket storm detected. Elevated 5xx + connection churn on enterprise app gateway. Paging Maya (oncall).

Maya (oncall): ack. I'm awake and grabbing the handoff. Notifying runtime and SRE. @ryan can you drop in? :phone:

Nora (sre): I'm here. Alerts show a spike in ws_disconnects and upstream_read_timeouts. Helion tenant connection count jumped from ~4k to ~18k over 3m on their dedicated pool, queueing began on shared edge routes.

Sam (eng): quick tail from appgw:
```
2026-03-15T15:22:03Z tenant=helion conn=1721 status=101->disconnect reason=client_retry
2026-03-15T15:22:04Z tenant=helion stream=0x9a latency_ms=1250 retry=2
2026-03-15T15:22:05Z proxy ERROR upstream read timeout
```
Looks like client retry storms + backend slow tails causing gateway backpressure and cascading retries.

Ryan (runtime): initial theory: our default ws_read_deadline is 30s; Helion's client retries with near-zero backoff so transient slow tokens lead to reconnect loops. Also seeing frequent prefix cache misses on their workload causing backend stalls.

Maya (oncall): Customer impact? Leo can you confirm with Helion support contact.

Leo (account): Helion reports widespread session drops, intermittent missing messages on long-lived streams. They're escalating internally — SLA exposure. Asking for ETA and short-term mitigation now.

Nora (sre): Mitigation options (ordered by speed):
- Flip ingress smoothing flag to enable reconnect smoothing (config toggle, immediate)
- Increase ws_read_deadline from 30s -> 90s (config toggle)
- Patch tenant per_tenant_conn_limit from 20000 -> 35000 (needs orchestrator patch, a few minutes)
- Apply ingress rate-limiter rules specific to helion to cap reconnect rate (deployable via config)
- Ask Helion to deploy client backoff ASAP (customer action)

Maya (oncall): Which give visible relief in 10-20m?

Ryan (runtime): Fastest: enable ingress smoothing + increase ws deadline. I can flip both without deploy. Patching tenant limit is next fastest — requires calling internal console API.

Sam (eng): I'll prepare the tenant patch command. Example:
```
curl -XPOST "https://internal-console.redwood/api/v1/tenants/helion/patch" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"per_tenant_conn_limit":35000}'
```

Maya (oncall): OK Ryan, do the toggles. Sam, stand by to patch. Leo, message Helion and ask them to throttle retries if possible.

Ryan (runtime): toggling `enable_stream_smoothing=true` and `ws_read_deadline=90s` now.

DeployBot: config-change: `enable_stream_smoothing` -> true by ryan at 1763234602. id cbf-helion-01
DeployBot: config-change: `ws_read_deadline` 30s -> 90s by ryan at 1763234605. id cbf-helion-02

Ryan (runtime): applied both. Dashboards show immediate reduction in reconnect rate, connection churn down ~35% within 60s. Watching for side effects.

Sam (eng): applying tenant patch now.

Sam (eng):
```
> curl ...
200 OK
{"tenant":"helion","per_tenant_conn_limit":35000}
```

Sam (eng): patch confirmed.

Nora (sre): Observability update: 5xx rate fell from 7.4% -> 1.5% over 4m, avg tail latency reduced ~30%. Queue depth on shared edge dropped. New limit appears sufficient for current burst.

Leo (account): Helion acknowledges. They said their infra team will ship a client-side bump to introduce exponential backoff within the hour. They appreciate the temporary config changes and asked for a compliance-friendly incident summary.

Maya (oncall): On-call plan: Nora monitors actively for 30m, then hand off to Ryan for follow-up on runtime fixes. Sam to profile backend prefix KV cache path that showed blocking disk reads. Leo to prepare customer-facing summary. I'll lower severity to P2 once stable for 15m.

Nora (sre): Filed follow-up INC ticket: INC-5421. Runbook attached: /runbooks/gateway-streaming-retries

Sam (eng): For postmortem: collecting trace IDs and noting that prefix KV cache miss triggered a synchronous disk fallback that blocked worker loops under high concurrent streams. Will include kernel/IO thread notes.

Ryan (runtime): Follow-ups we should track:
- implement tenant-adaptive smoothing that applies client reconnect damping when reconnect rate > threshold
- evaluate adjusting default ws_deadline for enterprise pools to 60s
- add automated routing to higher-capacity pools when queue_depth > X for a tenant

Maya (oncall): Good. I've documented current mitigations and will keep the thread live until P2 confirmed.

IncidentBot: Pager cleared for oncall. Severity changed to P2 at 1763234890 per Maya (oncall).

Maya (oncall): Closing active mitigation window. Leaving follow-ups assigned to respective owners. :white_check_mark:

Ryan (runtime): I'll pair with Sam tomorrow AM to reproduce and instrument the KV miss path.

Leo (account): I'll send Helion the incident summary and ticket links. They requested the timeline.

Nora (sre): Acknowledged. I'll keep the helion alert thresholds lowered and report in the postmortem.

Maya (oncall): Handoff complete. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
